method: Verified coinbase reward multiplied by the saved BlockSniper per-block price, with separately marked operator screenshot prices (BlockSniper notification or website display) and historical Coinbase candle fallbacks. Sum exact decimal products, then round the total half-up to cents.

blocks.observation_note: Operator-supplied screenshot of the BlockSniper block cards, recorded 2026-10-12: block 972535 shows a 3.125 BCH reward valued at $891.30. The per-BCH price 285.19 is that displayed value divided by the verified 3.12528740 BCH gross reward, rounded to cents; it reproduces $891.30 exactly. Rounded display evidence, not a database-verified snapshot. The same screenshot shows $893.59 for 972529, $896.29 for 972524 and $894.66 for 972517, matching the records here. Original image retained privately.

Operator-supplied screenshot recorded 2026-10-12: notification for block 972529 shows 3.06368033 BCH miner reward, approximately $875.72 at $285.84/BCH, and 0.06252408 BCH pool fee. Price is rounded display evidence, not a database-verified snapshot. Original image retained privately because it contains rental identifiers.
